main:
Spiritual Growth

It’s like a good cup of coffee, but for the soul

With your support we can offer more individuals a taste of abundant goodness – authenticity, joy and purpose.

Set more people on the path to spiritual growth and true happiness.

“I’m a newer, happier person”

I come from a totally secular background. I always felt, even as a young child, that there was something spiritual missing in my life. As a young adult, I began to lead a religious lifestyle. But still, something was missing. Eventually, over 12 years ago, when I first became a grandmother, I began to learn Rebbe Nachman’s teachings and to practice Hitbodedut for two hours a day over a period of seven years.

Today, I’m a new person and so much happier. Thank you Rabbi Kalmus for communicating in such an authentic and relevant way such that I am able to reconnect with what I thought was lost forever.

Bracha

There is nothing more liberating than joy!
